metadata.host_selection_rule: storage-only: direct child contract with most references; lexical canonical-id tie-break

semantics.per_origin_rule: Each source contribution records exact revision/snapshot/watermark evidence where available.
semantics.global_rule: No global atomic snapshot is claimed unless an explicit coordinated mechanism proves it.
semantics.time_rule: Wall-clock timestamps alone do not prove cross-origin consistency.
semantics.staleness_rule: Known source staleness is explicit result metadata.
semantics.replica_rule: Replica-derived sources retain authoritative-source and sync-watermark provenance.
semantics.query_rule: Consistency profile is explicit in query/execution/result metadata.
semantics.failure_rule: Unable-to-meet requested consistency hard-fails or downgrades only under explicit caller-approved policy.

invariants.rule: Federated DWH access preserves each origin's exact identity, schema, governance, lineage and consistency evidence; combining results never centralizes semantic ownership or silently expands authorization.

hard_gates.condition: multi-source result falsely claimed globally atomic
timestamps used as proof of global consistency
stale replica presented as current without watermark

references.purpose: Replica sources expose exact sync position.
